title: helichrysum teretifolium
intro: Helichrysum teretifolium, commonly known as Everlasting, is a flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to support skin health and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Helichrysum teretifolium include its potential to improve wound healing, reduce scarring, and alleviate pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
